explanation: Added the `new` keyword when instantiating the Stripe client to comply with version 22.0.0 where Stripe is a true ES6 class.
Updated stripe.customers.retrieve to pass the apiKey via the RequestOptions object as required in v22.0.0.
Converted the callback-based Stripe customer list call to use async/await as required by v22.0.0.
Renamed StripeClient.parseThinEvent to StripeClient.parseEventNotification as specified in the v19.0.0 breaking change.
Updated Stripe.webhooks() to use the new plain object property Stripe.webhooks directly per SDK v18.0.0 breaking change.
Renamed usage_threshold_config to usage_threshold on Billing.AlertCreateParams in accordance with SDK v17.0.0.
Renamed volume_decimal to quantity_decimal in the fuel purchase details according to the v16.0.0 SDK breaking change.
Renamed the `listUpcomingLineItems` method on the `Invoice` resource to `listUpcomingLines` as specified in the v10.0.0 SDK changelog.
Replaced the removed `retrieveDetails` method call with a TODO comment and an Error throw since no direct method replacement was provided in the changelog.
Renamed stripe.checkoutSessions to stripe.checkout.sessions to align with the SDK v6.21.0 namespace and class rename.
Added a TODO comment above the read of the removed expires_after field as there is no direct replacement.
Renamed usage_threshold_config to usage_threshold on Billing.Alert according to the v17.0.0 SDK breaking change.
Added optional chaining to the read of offer.end_behavior.transition since it became optional in v22.7.0-alpha.4.
